title: Bottom bracket makes a grinding noise problem, need advice
main: My bottom bracket makes a grinding noise if I ride in the rain and the shop could not reproduce it. My rear derailleur starts clicking whenever I leave it overnight and the shop could not reproduce it.
Try a different valve core before anything else. The rear wheel hub loses pressure after I brake hard on descents so I am not sure what to check next.
I had the same issue last spring. The chain on my road bike keeps slipping when I leave it overnight and the shop could not reproduce it.
